name: speedtest-monorepo
description: A production-quality internet speed test platform: CLI + local Web UI sharing one real network test engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/engine && npm run test -w packages/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w packages/server && npm run typecheck -w packages/cli && npm run typecheck -w packages/web
